corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez preposition/adverbial phrase 'ወእምዝ' (and after this, Luke 1:23) uses 6th-order 'እ', which was misread as 1st-order 'አ'.

Joined across the line wrap from L27 ('የተፍኅሮቱ ነገር እንደምን ነው' - 'how is the matter of the betrothal?'), the final character on the image clearly has the crossbar and right-side vowel mark of 'ቱ', misread as 'ስ'.
